description: A Holoscan Module extending the Holoscan SDK.

__prompts__.project_name: Human-readable module name (e.g. 'My Sensor'). See modules/README.md for the full naming system.
__prompts__.module_slug: snake_case identifier — auto-derived from project_name. Used for the C++ namespace (e.g. 'my_sensor').
__prompts__.module_repo_name: kebab-case repo/package name — auto-derived, prefixed 'holoscan-' (e.g. 'holoscan-my-sensor'). Used for the Debian package.
__prompts__.operator_slug: Initial operator name in snake_case (e.g. 'my_sensor_op'). CamelCase class name is derived.
__prompts__.language: Languages: 'cpp', or 'cpp,python' to add Python bindings for the C++ operators (pure-Python Modules return in a later release)
__prompts__.holoscan_version: Minimum Holoscan SDK version required (5.0.0 or later)
__prompts__.contact_email: Maintainer contact email (used in Debian package metadata)
